name: apple-reminders
description: Read and manage native Apple Reminders from Codex or ChatGPT

interface.shortDescription: Tell your AI. It’s on your list.
interface.longDescription: Apple Reminders lets Codex and ChatGPT list, search, read, create, update, complete, reopen, and delete native reminders on this Mac. Mutations target one exact reminder ID, and bulk destructive actions are not exposed.
defaultPrompt: What reminders are still open for school?
Remind me to submit my assignment tomorrow at 4 PM.
Mark my submit assignment reminder complete.
